milestones.title: Verify component c01 at grouping level 1
Verify component c02 at grouping level 1

S1.instruction: Write one permitted Python integer expression for base using only floor, multiplier, x, and y: max(0, x-floor)*multiplier+y.

S2.instruction: Write one permitted Python integer expression for adjusted using only base, cap, rate, and z. Add rate*z to base and clamp the result to the inclusive interval [0, cap].

S3.instruction: Write one permitted Python integer expression for total using only adjusted, bonus, and z: add bonus when z is nonnegative, and subtract bonus otherwise.

S4.instruction: After c01_total passes, certify component c01 by recording environment_revision as the current c01 component revision (currently 0) and checked_gates exactly as ["c01_total"]. Confirm the referenced gate passes.

S5.instruction: Write the permitted Python integer expression for base using only floor, multiplier, x, and y: max(0, x-floor)*multiplier+y. For c02, use the current values floor=5 and multiplier=3, yielding max(0, x-5)*3+y.

S6.instruction: Write one permitted Python integer expression for adjusted using only base, cap, rate, and z. Add rate*z to base and clamp the result to the inclusive interval [0, cap].

S7.instruction: Write one permitted Python integer expression for total using only adjusted, bonus, and z: add bonus when z is nonnegative, and subtract bonus otherwise.

S8.instruction: After c02_total passes, certify component c02 by recording environment_revision as the current c02 component revision (currently 0) and checked_gates exactly as ["c02_total"]. Confirm the referenced gate passes.
